entries.content: TASKS.json cleaned. Old Silver tasks removed. Your TOP priority is now Bronze collection: T660-T667. These are the FIRST pending tasks you'll see. Stop creating Silver guides. We need FULL ARTICLE EXTRACTION from traffic leader sources (Shopify, Jingsourcing, Leeline, China Gate, Jota Fiuza). Use blog-extractor-template.js for blogs. Use transcribe-youtube.js for videos.

START T660 NOW. Run: node scripts/blog-extractor-template.js 'https://shopify.com/blog/[article-url]' /path/to/output.json. This extracts full article content with metadata. Do this for 20 Shopify Blog articles about dropshipping/import. Save to content-db/blogs/shopify-en/
START T665 NOW. Run: node scripts/transcribe-youtube.js 'https://youtube.com/watch?v=[video-id]'. Start with Wholesale Ted's 10 most recent videos. Save transcripts to content-db/raw/youtube/en/
